```yaml
name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release'
        required: true
        type: string
      is_dev:
        description: 'Is this a dev release?'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: linux
            arch: amd64
            target: linux-amd64
          - os: linux
            arch: arm64
            target: linux-arm64
          - os: darwin
            arch: amd64
            target: darwin-amd64
          - os: darwin
            arch: arm64
            target: darwin-arm64
          - os: windows
            arch: amd64
            target: windows-amd64
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          python -m build --wheel
          # Create a simple binary wrapper or archive the wheel for distribution
          # Adjust this step based on your actual build process
          mkdir -p dist/${{ matrix.target }}
          cp dist/*.whl dist/${{ matrix.target }}/ha-mcp-${{ matrix.target }}.whl

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: binaries-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/${{ matrix.target }}/*
          retention-days: 1

  create-release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
      release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
      is_draft: ${{ steps.set_draft.outputs.is_draft }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version and type
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
            IS_DEV="${{ github.event.inputs.is_dev }}"
          else
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
            # Check if version contains 'dev' or 'rc' or similar
            if [[ "$VERSION" == *"dev"* ]] || [[ "$VERSION" == *"rc"* ]] || [[ "$VERSION" == *"alpha"* ]] || [[ "$VERSION" == *"beta"* ]]; then
              IS_DEV="true"
            else
              IS_DEV="false"
            fi
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "is_dev=$IS_DEV" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set draft flag
        id: set_draft
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.version.outputs.is_dev }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "is_draft=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_draft=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          draft: ${{ steps.set_draft.outputs.is_draft }}
          prerelease: ${{ steps.version.outputs.is_dev == 'true' }}
          generate_release_notes: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  upload-assets:
    needs: [build, create-release]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: linux
            arch: amd64
            target: linux-amd64
          - os: linux
            arch: arm64
            target: linux-arm64
          - os: darwin
            arch: amd64
            target: darwin-amd64
          - os: darwin
            arch: arm64
            target: darwin-arm64
          - os: windows
            arch: amd64
            target: windows-amd64
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: binaries-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/${{ matrix.target }}/*
          asset_name: ha-mcp-${{ matrix.target }}.whl
          asset_content_type: application/zip

  publish-release:
    needs: [create-release, upload-assets]
    if: needs.create-release.outputs.is_draft == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          else
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Publish Draft Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          draft: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
